clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau didn't write his first book until after he'd generated about $18 billion in sales.

His pointed question for the personal-development world: Tony Robbins, Bob Proctor, Joe Vitale, Brian Tracy - great teachers, but they made their money selling courses on how to succeed, not from building a business first.

His challenge to them: if you know so much, how come you don't just build one and make a billion dollars first?

So that's what he did - a marketing empire, TV networks, mining operations - before he ever wrote a word of advice.

Would you trust advice more from someone who built it, or someone who just teaches it?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #businesstips #wealthmindset #successhabits #financialfreedom

A business owner Kevin Trudeau knows built a company doing $150 million a year - and hit a wall. His answer was to hire more people.

Kevin's response: your sales are flat, but your profits keep shrinking, because your overhead keeps growing. You're pushing a rope.

His friend Al Dunlap - nicknamed Chainsaw Al, a turnaround expert - had the opposite instinct: cut expenses everywhere. Even if sales dip 10%, profits jump. Profit, not revenue, is the money that actually lands in your pocket - or moves your stock price if you're public.

Everyone tries to throw money at a growth problem. The fix is usually the opposite.

#kevintrudeau #businesstips #entrepreneur #wealthmindset #profitfirst #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau says most business owners set their monthly targets wrong.

They aim for $100,000 or $200,000, miss it every single month, and never notice they're training themselves to lose.

His fix: aim for $80,000 instead. Hit it in the first week, and you've banked a win - you're ahead of schedule, building momentum. It's the same reason a struggling football team calls a short, easy pass first: momentum comes from wins, not from reaching.

Set the number you'll actually beat, then let the beating compound.

What target are you currently missing every month?

#kevintrudeau #businesstips #entrepreneur #wealthmindset #successhabits #goalsetting

Walt Disney's first cartoon character wasn't Mickey Mouse.

He created one with four business partners, meant to make him rich and famous. Then his partners manipulated the contract and took it from him. Disney fought to get it back and finally admitted he couldn't.

Then he said something that mattered more than the character itself: they stole it, but they didn't steal his ability to create.

So he created another one. The stolen character was called Oswald the Rabbit. Almost nobody remembers Oswald. Everybody remembers what Disney made next: Mickey Mouse.

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #successstory #wealthmindset #businesstips #mindset

A man walks up to the gate of an ancient walled city and asks the guard what the people inside are like.

Tell me first, the guard says, what were the people like where you came from? Terrible, the man says - dishonest, mean, nothing but thieves. That's why I left. The guard sighs: I'm sorry, you'll find those same people here.

Later that night, another traveler asks the same question. Wonderful people, he says - honest, hardworking, warm. I just wanted to see more of the world. Good news, the guard tells him: you'll find those exact same people here too.

You create the life you want wherever you go.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #mindset #lawofattraction #selfawareness #personalgrowth

Someone came to Kevin Trudeau when Bitcoin was trading at $20 and told him to buy in.

He said no - fake money, made no sense to him. It came back around at $20,000. Still made no sense to him. He missed it completely.

Here's how he lets himself off the hook for that: you never actually get it wrong. You either win, or you learn. Most people are so afraid of a bad decision that they never make one. He says there's no such thing as a bad decision - only a perfect one, because either outcome teaches you something.

What opportunity are you still punishing yourself for missing?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #wealthmindset #investing #entrepreneur #successhabits

clips.end_words: in alignment with who I am
clips.caption:
Before Kevin Trudeau says yes to any deal, he asks one question first: is this in alignment with who I am?

A friend once pitched him on a chain of strip clubs - "we're going to make a fortune." Kevin told him plainly: you're going to make a lot of money. And he did - it just wasn't a fit for who Kevin was, so he passed.

Most people skip this question and jump straight to the money. He asks it first, every time, because a deal that's out of alignment goes sideways eventually, no matter how good the numbers look.

What deal are you chasing that isn't actually you?

#kevintrudeau #entrepreneur #businesstips #mindset #wealthmindset #successhabits

Kevin Trudeau's real risk test has nothing to do with the upside.

Most people ask what can I make first. He asks what's the actual worst case first - and forces total honesty about it. Not just I lose $100,000. The real worst case might be losing the money and getting sued on top of it.

Then: can I actually handle that, financially and emotionally? Only after answering yes does he even look at the upside. Skip that order and a $10 million upside next to a $1 million downside gets you greedy - thinking about the ten, not the mortgage on the house you'd lose.

If the worst case costs you your house, it's not the right deal for you.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #businesstips #investing #entrepreneur #riskmanagement
